# Third-party assets

## Lin Mo character

- Source: PolygonalMind/100Avatars, avatar 069 "Kyle"
- Files: `Resources/Models/Characters/LinMo.fbx`, `100Avatars_069_Kyle.png`
- Source URL: https://github.com/PolygonalMind/100Avatars/tree/master/100Avatars_069
- License: CC0, as stated by the project's GitHub release page.
- Integration changes: renamed the FBX for the game, generated a URP material, retargeted it to Unity Humanoid, and assigned locomotion animation.

## Village environment

- Source: KayKit Medieval Hexagon Pack 1.0
- Source URL: https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Medieval-Hexagon-Pack-1.0
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal; the original `LICENSE.txt` is included as `KayKit-Medieval-CC0.txt`.
- Used assets: homes, watermill, blacksmith, bridge, mountains, trees, rocks, water plants, barrels, wheelbarrow, lumber and sacks.

## Character animation

- Source integration: PixelWizards/simple-character-controller
- Original animation sources: Unity Standard Assets / Starter Assets
- Source URL: https://github.com/PixelWizards/simple-character-controller
- License: Unity Companion License for the animation files. The source notice is included as `Unity-Animations-Companion-License.md`.
- Controller code remains original to this project; only four humanoid clips are used (idle, walk, run and jump).
